<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$checks = array(
  'stylesheet' => get_stylesheet(),
  'fetch_function' => function_exists('gatilab_br_get_payload'),
  'validator_function' => function_exists('gatilab_br_validate_payload'),
  'categories' => function_exists('gatilab_br_categories') ? count(gatilab_br_categories()) : 0,
  'hub_template' => file_exists(get_stylesheet_directory() . '/templates/blog-rankings-hub.php'),
  'category_template' => file_exists(get_stylesheet_directory() . '/templates/blog-ranking-category.php'),
);
if ($checks['stylesheet'] !== 'md-new' || !$checks['fetch_function'] || !$checks['validator_function'] || $checks['categories'] !== 10 || !$checks['hub_template'] || !$checks['category_template']) {
  throw new Exception(wp_json_encode($checks));
}
echo wp_json_encode($checks);
